newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gammon says wins $13.5 mln contract in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Gammon says wins $13.5 mln contract in Vietnam.

text.p: Gammon Construction Ltd said on Monday its joint venture company, GAMVICO, had been awarded a US$13.5 million contract from Doan Ket International Co Ltd, a subsidiary of Hong Kong Land (Vietnam) Ltd, for structure works of a retail and office building in Hanoi, Vietnam.

GAMVICO, a joint venture between Gammon and Construction Co No 1 of Hanoi Construction Co, would build the superstructure of a grade A retail and office building containing a basement and ground floor, seven office floors and a roof penthouse/mechanical floor, with a gross floor area of 11,335 square meters, it said in a statement.
Gammom is an associate of Norway's Kvaerner ASA.
